My Purpose My purpose is to transmute pain into power by holding space for stories the world has silenced. I stand at the intersection of trauma and transformation, memory and movement, voice and vision. Through performance, spoken word, and soul-led storytelling, I resurrect what colonialism, war, and personal loss tried to bury. I am here to remind people and myself that healing isn’t linear, art isn’t decoration, and purpose isn’t performance it’s presence. I create spaces where the forgotten are remembered, where the broken become whole through beauty, and where the shadow and the light dance as one. I choose to believe the blueprint. I choose to walk in the embodiment of my future self now. I am here to ignite. To unearth. To liberate. This is not an accident. This is alignment.
